pick.headline: Geneva Accords on Afghanistan signed
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of April 14, 1988, listed Afghanistan and Pakistan items on the accords: Junejo addressing the nation, Zia and Junejo hailing the agreement, and refugees in Iran protesting the Geneva agreements.
